### Comment by [@yuluo-yx](https://github.com/yuluo-yx) — 2026-06-04T13:34:14Z

> #11915

I check it and confirmed, this PR should cover both #11914 and #11915.

 #11914 fails at test/e2e/multikueue/baseline/e2e_test.go:1243 while waiting for the MultiKueue Job to  complete with the default 45s MediumTimeout. This PR changes that exact path to use  ExpectJobToBeCompletedWithTimeout(..., util.LongTimeout) for both jobs in that test.

#11915 fails at test/e2e/multikueue/baseline/tas_test.go:647 while waiting for the TAS workload to reach WorkloadFinished=True/Succeeded with MediumTimeout. This PR changes that exact wait to util.LongTimeout.

Both failures are from the same Prow run and match the same class of delay: after the test terminates the pod, pod/job terminal status propagation can take longer than 45s in CI. I will update the PR description to include #11914 and #11915 as fixed issues as well.

## Walkthrough

This PR addresses flaky E2E tests in MultiKueue by introducing a configurable timeout helper for job completion assertions and applying longer timeouts to tests experiencing race conditions in TAS topology routing and cross-cluster job scheduling.

## Changes

**E2E Test Timeout Reliability**

| Layer / File(s) | Summary |
|---|---|
| **Timeout-configurable job completion helper** <br> `test/util/util.go` | `ExpectJobToBeCompletedWithTimeout(ctx, c, job, timeout)` is added to allow explicit timeout control. The existing `ExpectJobToBeCompleted(ctx, c, job)` is refactored to delegate to the new helper with `MediumTimeout` as the default, preserving backward compatibility. |
| **Apply longer timeouts to flaky tests** <br> `test/e2e/multikueue/baseline/e2e_test.go`, `test/e2e/multikueue/baseline/tas_test.go` | The "Cluster Role Sharing" e2e test and two TAS topology tests use `LongTimeout` instead of default or `MediumTimeout` for job and workload completion assertions, giving flaky tests more time to complete without timing out. |

## Estimated code review effort

🎯 2 (Simple) | ⏱️ ~8 minutes

## Suggested labels

`area/tas`

## Poem

> 🐰 A timeout that grows when tests need more space,  
> No more flaky failures losing the race,  
> TAS jobs now finish with time to spare,  
> Topology routing works with patient care! 🎯

</details>
